complete_examples.text: When the fault displacement is 30 mm and 40 mm with train speed below 200 km/h, the derailment coefficient changes in the range of 0.16–0.55 in P-PRBT and 0.14– 0.54 in CRTS III.
It is noted that in P-PRBT, under fault dislocation of 30 mm and 40 mm, when the vehicle speed reaches 200 km/h, the derailment coefficient reaches 0.89 and 0.92, which exceeds the safety standard.
